title: No Lag Pack
description: A perfected optimization modpack with no conflicts and amazing performance.
body:
No Lag is a lightweight performance modpack for players who want to play vanilla Minecraft, modpack creators who want a clean base, and players who want to play on multiplayer servers without lag.

Each mod in this pack was tested for their performance effects, conflicts and overlaps, so there should be no useless or lag‑causing mods. The goal is to include only mods that improve performance.

### Features

- Stable server tick times
- Faster chunk loading
- Higher and more consistent FPS
- Lower CPU, GPU, and RAM usage
- No known mod conflicts or overlapping systems
- Stable performance in singleplayer and multiplayer
  
### Designed for

- Anyone who wants Minecraft to run better without gameplay changes
- Players who want to play multiplayer servers without lag
- Modpack creators who want a base for their own modpacks
- Servers and SMPs

### Note
- This modpack doesn't only optimize fps, it also optimizes server ticks, which other modpacks don't do much. Which makes this great for a bigger modpack base.
